title: Select and materialize the next reuse-first capability wave
goal: Validate the fresh reuse-first-v1 recommendation after CAP-INV-006 ledger registration and materialize exactly one next bounded implementation wave without mutating existing verified product runtimes.
inputs: VERIFIED E10-SCALE-005A readiness and wave-selection evidence
invariants: verified product runtime code is not changed by scaling-control tasks
selection follows compiled READY evidence rather than manual preference
security_properties: selected capability path must resolve inside the read-only Product Spec
wave decomposition must preserve deny-by-default security requirements
tasks exceeding complexity budgets must be split
acceptance_tests: implementation-wave selects exactly one READY capability
generated child manifests pass strict-v2 and complexity validation
one first child is READY and later children are dependency-gated

performance_budget.rationale: control-plane decomposition only; runtime budgets are compiled in the selected capability child work

migration.rationale: no product runtime or persistent data is changed

rollback.strategy: revert wave materialization without changing verified runtimes or ledger entries

definition_of_ready: fresh wave compiler selects one READY capability
definition_of_done: child lots stay within complexity budgets
one next READY implementation task exists
